title: St. Patrick's Day Board
seo_title: St. Patrick's Day Charcuterie Board for 8–12: Shopping & Plan
description: A St. Patrick's Day charcuterie board for 8–12: Irish cheddar, Irish Gouda, corned beef, banger slices, soda bread, green grapes, kiwi and whiskey jam.
hook: Irish flavors and festive green: Irish cheddar, corned beef and soda bread, with green fruit for color.
why: Irish grass-fed cheddar is rich and buttery, and corned beef next to it adds a salty, savory bite. Bangers, the classic Irish sausage, make it hearty, and soda bread with whipped cream cheese is the board's most-grabbed pairing.
Green grapes, green apple and kiwi carry the theme without food coloring, and their tartness cuts the rich cheese. Whole-grain mustard and whiskey jam bring the sharp and the sweet.

timeline.what: Take the cheeses and meats out of the fridge.
Slice the cheddar and the soda bread; fill the small bowls.
Place the cheeses; spoon out the jam and mustard.
Fan the meats; add the grapes, apple and kiwi.

faq.q: What goes on a St. Patrick's Day charcuterie board?
faq.a: Irish cheddar, Irish Gouda, corned beef, bangers, salami, soda bread, pumpernickel, green grapes, green apple, kiwi, pistachios, whole-grain mustard and whiskey jam.

faq.q: What Irish cheese should I buy?
faq.a: Irish cheddar is easy to find in most supermarkets. Kerrygold makes both cheddar and Gouda-style cheeses.
Slice the cheese and soda bread a few hours ahead and keep them wrapped. Cut the apple last so it doesn't brown. Leave it out no more than 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90°F.
